notes.title: 🚀 Patch Notes – Version 2.0
notes.content:
Hey Commanders!
This update brings huge new features, bug fixes, and performance boosts to take your cube-blasting experience to the next level!



🎯 [b]New Campaign Mode[/b]
Ready for a real challenge?
We’ve added a brand-new Campaign Mode, featuring 6 handcrafted missions with increasing difficulty.
Between each mission, upgrade your defenses and prepare for what’s next. Can you beat them all?



🛸 [b]Pilot Your Own Ship![/b]
Introducing a game-changing feature: spaceship control!
Take direct control of your own assault ship and wreak havoc among enemy cubes!

[b]Unlock and upgrade 3 powerful weapons:[/b]
Auto-Cannon – Automatically targets enemies near your pointer.
Rocket Launcher – Devastating area damage with style.
Mega Bomb – Drop it like it’s hot and flatten enemies beneath you.



🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug affecting Blitz mode.
Fixed an issue with enemy unit spawning.
Fixed a bug where XP gain wasn’t properly counted.


⚙️ [b]Performance Improvements[/b]
Optimized enemy cube movement for smoother gameplay.

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes - Version 1.11
notes.content:
✅ Fixes :
-Improved several incorrect translations across menus and UI.
-Fixed a sound bug that occurred when too many units were present on screen.
-Fixed an issue with the "Blitz" spell that could cause infinite experience generation.

✨ Improvements:
-Current XP and level are now displayed in the interface.
-The current difficulty level is now visible in-game.
-New upgrades are now visually distinguishable from those already unlocked.



💬 Thank you for playing Cube Guardian! I'm doing my best to fix as many issues as possible and take your feedback into account. Keep it coming, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Cube Guardian 1.1
notes.content:
🧊 Cube Guardian - Patch 1.1 🔥
New Features:

🪄 Spell System Added!
Spells are now part of the game! A total of 5 unique spells can be unlocked through random upgrades starting from difficulty level 10:

Fire Spell: Rain fire on your enemies, dealing magical damage in a target area.

Ice Spell: Freeze enemies in a selected zone. Frozen enemies are unable to move towards your nexus.

Healing Spell: Restore your nexus's health with a burst of healing magic.

Blitz Spell: Temporarily boosts XP gain, helping you unlock new abilities faster!

Boost Spell: Temporarily enhances all turrets within a target zone, increasing their stats by 50% for devastating results.

💠 Mana Resource
Mana has been added as a new resource starting at difficulty level 10. Some enemies will now drop mana upon death, fueling your spells for maximum impact!

🛩️ Flying Enemies
Beware! Starting from level 10, groups of flying enemies will attack your nexus. These enemies do not follow the usual paths, so make sure to defend your nexus from all sides!

Bug Fixes:

Fixed unexpected crashes during gameplay

Corrected game time calculation issues

Improved enemy selection system responsiveness

Various other minor bug fixes and stability improvements

We hope these additions will make your gameplay experience even more exciting and strategic! ⚔️🧠
Thank you for playing Cube Guardian!
